desc: Decode the TPS6598x/AppleHPM POWER-role path for the right port, replacing the withdrawn SWDF premise (tickets 105/106 NO-GO, done/2026-07-28-t6040-r3-r4-crossreview-no-go.md). SWDF/SWUF are DATA-role (DFP/UFP); sourcing VBUS needs the power-role command SWSr (and SWSk to revert). REQUIRED, all offline from the paired kernelcache /private/tmp/t6040-ipsw + our captured ADT: (1) locate the AppleHPM caller that issues SWSr/SWSk (roleSwap is data-role only — find the power-role sibling, likely near AppleHPM::atomic4CC callers; note 096 previously found NO VBUS primitive and setAccessoryPower is a kIOReturnUnsupported stub, so establish whether a power-role 4CC path exists AT ALL before assuming one); (2) its exact DATA1 payload and CMD1 byte order; (3) a READ that reports data role, power role, orientation and VBUS state so a run is verifiable rather than blind; (4) the byte-exact inverse. Then a new candidate + cross-review + attended KIS-observable run. Do NOT infer VBUS from SWDF. If no power-role 4CC exists in the kext, record that as the finding and pivot to ticket 170's upstream Type-C stack route.
author: claude
